user_story: As a user, I want to log into the application using my credentials so that I can access secure areas. Acceptance Criteria: 1. The login form is displayed when I visit the URL 'https://the-internet.herokuapp.com/login'. 2. I can enter my username in the input field with id 'username'. 3. I can enter my password in the input field with id 'password'. 4. When I click the 'Login' button (class 'radius'), I am redirected to a logged-in page (not specified here, but the URL should change). 5. If I submit an empty form, the URL remains the same and the 'Login Page' heading is still visible.
